attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 16.04), built a local apt package repository under /srv/localrepo (containing sl_3.03-17build1_i386.deb plus a dpkg-scanpackages-generated Packages/Packages.gz index), served it via `python3 -m http.server` bound to $NODE_IP:8080. Blocked the usual remote repos (iptables REJECT on tcp/80 and tcp/443, confirmed with a timed-out curl to archive.ubuntu.com) and pointed /etc/apt/sources.list exclusively at the local repo. Ran `apt-get update` (succeeded from local repo only) and `apt-get install -y sl` (installed successfully with remotes unreachable), verified via dpkg -s and the installed binary at /usr/games/sl. Afterward restored the original iptables rules, original sources.list and sources.list.d, confirmed remote reachability and apt-get update against real repos again, and stopped the local HTTP server. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline (6ab98831...) and package health, triggered `reboot` via backgrounded sudo command so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until SSH/exec access returned, confirmed a new boot_id (7a161f2f...) proving an actual restart, and verified post-restart that sl remained installed, apt sources were the restored originals, iptables was clean, and remote repo connectivity worked (HTTP 200).
